title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.4 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab Enterprise Edition (EE) versions from 17.4 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to cause a denial of service impacting Duo usage analytics due to improper input validation. This issue has been remediated by GitLab in the specified fixed versions.
